example_rule: First (task_id, sample, seed) in each nonempty control/penalty success cell; four illustrations, not representative effect estimates.
limitations: One training seed and reused inspected development tasks.
Control differs in deterministic runtime; later trajectories are not shared between policies.
Same-row reward rescoring reconstructs estimator support, not a trained counterfactual.
Clipping acts before Adam; norm or update count cannot establish the cause of the endpoint.
No intermediate checkpoint evaluation, new hypotheses or inferential tests are retroactively registered.
